sections.heading: Sauce for Eating with the Duck (甜麵醬)

items: Clean a duck weighing 4-5 LB with warm water and hang it up to dry.

Baste the duck thoroughly in the sauce and dry in the air for 4-6 hours. Use a stick to hold the wings open and use a 300° oven to roast the duck for 1½ hours then turn the oven up to 350° and roast ½ hour more.
While the duck is roasting, prepare the sauce for eating with the duck (listed above). Cook all of the above ingredients together at low heat for about 2 minutes.
Make about 20 pancakes and keep them warm. Cut the white part off of about 20 scallions and set aside.
Roll the roast duck, duck sauce, and scallion up and eat when the duck is hot.

Bring the water to a boil and add the duck bones, mushrooms, scallion, ginger, and cabbage and let it simmer for 15 minutes. Add the carrot, pea pods, bean sprouts, salt, wine, MSG, and sesame seed oil. Cook momentarily and serve.

In a clean pan, use low heat to pan fry the peppercorn, until it smells good. Add salt to the peppercorn, stir fry together, then place in a bowl and let it cool down. Add the scallion, ginger and wine.
Clean the duck and thoroughly dry it. Rub it inside and out with the peppercorn mixture from (1) above and marinate for at least 6 hours and not more than 24 hours.
Place the duck in a pie tin in a wok full of boiling water and steam it for 3 hours over a high heat. May be steamed for 6 hours over a low heat.

Let the duck cool off and dry. Rub the duck evenly with the soy sauce and dust it with the flour. Deep fry the duck in the 8 cups of oil, remove it from the oil and when the oil is hot again, deep fry the duck again until very brown and crispy. Serve with steamed buns.
Soak the dates in cold water for 30 minutes. Then place them in hot water, boil for 20 minutes and set aside.

Place the ham in a small bowl, add a little water and steam it for 15 minutes. Allow the ham to cool and slice it thin. Place the ham in the bowl and arrange the slices in a pattern. Add the rock candy, and wine and steam the ham for 30 minutes.
Add the dates and steam for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove the liquid from the bowl and invert the bowl onto a serving platter.
Pour the liquid in a wok, add the cornstarch, honey and cinnamon powder and pour the mixture over the ham. Serve hot.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1 Cup chicken, beef or uncooked shrimp
4 Cups assorted onion, bamboo shoot, water chestnuts, mushrooms, pea pods, green pepper, cabbage and celery
Cook all vegetables in 8 Cups of boiling water until done without overcooking it. Drain well and set aside.
Heat 1 TBS oil in the wok and stir fry the meat. Add the vegetable and Mixture A. Bring the wok to a boil and add Mixture B. Stir well, add the sesame seed oil and then serve hot.
Cover the tripe with water in a saucepan. Add 1 TB wine and simmer for 1/2 hour until tender. Immediately cool with cold water and cut into very thin strips about 1 inch long.
Marinate the tripe in all the ingredients for about 1/2 hour and chill in the refrigerator. Serve cold.
